note: Adversarial cases written by an independent reviewer on 2026-11-09 to break the TRK-2 question wording and the claim guard (docs/gauntlet/BASELINE.md). Each case is one decide request: a script section with its open points, a short transcript, and for each point whether a careful human would say the speaker has covered it (true, false, or null when arguable; null is not counted). The labels are one reviewer's judgement. guardProbes are true points said with an unrelated or supporting negation: the guard should let them pass.
